description_en: Queries a list of on-duty engineers in a shift schedule
description_zh: 获取值班表的值班人员列表
name: ListShiftPersonnels

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the shift schedule
parameters.name: shift_schedule_identifier

parameters.help_en: The type of the on-duty engineer that you want to query. Valid values: ALL, PRIMARY, BACKUP, and DESIGNATED_USER
parameters.help_zh: 值班人查询条件：ALL（全部值班人）、PRIMARY（主值班人）、BACKUP（备值班人）、DESIGNATED_USER（指定人）
parameters.name: user_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You can log on to the DataWorks console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner to view the ID
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云账号ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台，鼠标悬停至顶部菜单栏右侧的用户头像，查看账号ID
parameters.name: shift_person_uid

parameters.help_en: The time when the on-duty engineer starts a shift. Set the value to a UNIX timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 值班人开始时间，时间戳
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The time when the on-duty engineer ends a shift. Set the value to a UNIX timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 值班人结束时间，时间戳
parameters.name: end_time
